name: Seitokai no Ichizon Lv.2 Portable
original_name: 生徒会の一存 Lv.2 PORTABLE
source: Once again, the player gets into the shoes of Ken Sugisaki and enjoys the rambles of the girls in the student council. If he desires, he can partake in their conversations or not. And depending on his choices, he'll obtain cards that will later let him enjoy "imagination events", where his fantasies go wild!
translation: 玩家再次扮演杉崎谦，享受学生会女孩们的闲聊。如果他愿意，他可以参与也可以不参与他们的谈话。根据他的选择，他将获得卡牌，这些卡牌将让他享受“想象力事件”，在那里他的幻想变得疯狂！
